name: Three Minute Descent
loop: Eight masked chart rooms; in each, go long, short or flat on the next 20 bars with paper capital. Drawdown past 25% ends the run.
hook: Short, fair, one more try; ascension adds rules not rewards.
risk: Unlimited retries may encourage compulsive replay.

name: Seeded Daily Dungeon
loop: Everyone gets the same seeded sequence of masked chart rooms and relic offers once a day; best risk-adjusted paper return tops the board.
hook: Shared seed makes water-cooler comparisons possible.
risk: Leaderboard pressure; keep rank out of verified-record surfaces.

name: Confidence Tokens
loop: Start with five confidence tokens. Each room you state a probability the chart rises; a miss costs tokens in proportion to how confident you were. Zero tokens ends the run.
hook: Overconfidence is the thing that kills you, which teaches calibration.
risk: Tokens could be mistaken for currency; keep them non-transferable.

name: Relic of Patience
loop: Between rooms pick one relic that changes a rule, such as halving fees but forcing a minimum hold of 5 bars. Hold the button to ride a position through the room.
hook: Rule-bending relics create build identity without random loot.
risk: Synthetic paths must be labelled or trust in real records erodes.

name: Bankroll Stairs
loop: Each floor raises the paper capital target you must hit to climb. Split capital across three masked charts; miss the floor target and the run ends.
hook: Clear stakes per floor, ghost shows your best prior run.
risk: Escalating target mimics chasing losses.

name: One Life Interval
loop: Drag a range you think the chart's next 10 bars will stay inside. Narrow correct ranges earn a streak; one miss on a boss room ends the run.
hook: Tight but right feels like skill, not luck.
risk: Boss permadeath could feel punishing to new players.

name: Ascension Ladder
loop: Clear a run to unlock the next ascension, each adding a rule: wider spreads, shorter drawdown limit, hidden last bar. Friends compare highest ascension cleared.
hook: Difficulty ladder gives mastery goals.
risk: None major; ensure no pay-to-skip.

name: Drawdown Fuse
loop: A burning fuse shrinks as paper drawdown grows. Ride trends to rebuild the fuse; when it burns out, the run ends.
hook: Visible fuse makes risk tangible in two minutes.
risk: Tension mechanics can feel like gambling; no sound rewards on wins.

name: Reveal Reckoning
loop: After each room the ticker and date are revealed with a one-line market context card that is stored in your codex. Run ends after three wrong calls.
hook: Collecting regimes in a codex rewards learning history.
risk: Reveal text must avoid naming companies' brands if vendor-neutral; context must not read as advice.

name: Fee Gauntlet
loop: Swipe right to go long, left to go short, with every flip charged a paper fee. Relics change fee structure. Overtrading drains the bankroll and ends the run.
hook: Punishes churn, matching the app's no-frequency-rewards rule.
risk: Teaches that trading is costly, a feature; avoid glamorising shorting.

name: Mirror Run Ghost
loop: Play the seed against a ghost built from the median choices of everyone who played it earlier. Beat the crowd ghost's paper return to move up the rating.
hook: Beating the crowd is a clear target on a fixed seed.
risk: Herding: showing the crowd may anchor choices; reveal ghost after.

name: Boss Gap Night
loop: Every fifth room is a boss: an overnight gap. Set a probability for gap direction; log scoring means a confident miss deals huge damage to your health bar.
hook: Boss rooms teach tail-risk in a memorable moment.
risk: Log loss is hard to explain; needs simple health-bar framing.

name: Relic Draft Fork
loop: Between rooms choose 1 of 3 rule relics, such as a stop that is free but wide. Send a link to a friend to replay your exact seed and relic path.
hook: Compare builds on identical seeds.
risk: Challenge links can be spammy; rate limit invites.

name: Cold Open Hardcore
loop: One attempt per day, no relics, one wrong call ends it. Score is the number of consecutive correct masked calls.
hook: Pure and tense; the daily limit prevents grinding.
risk: Streak multipliers can foster loss aversion; cap displayed streak.

name: Capital Chip Stack
loop: Start with ten paper chips. Stack chips on up to three charts each room; chips on losers vanish. Zero chips ends the run.
hook: Chips make position sizing visible and simple.
risk: Chip metaphor resembles casino play; use neutral visuals.

name: Fog of Bars
loop: Each ascension reveals fewer past bars before you must call direction: 60, 40, 20, 10. Clear all four to finish the ladder.
hook: Difficulty shaped by information, not by money.
risk: With few bars outcomes approach coin flips; luck dominates.

name: Volatility Weather
loop: Each room has a weather tag (calm, storm) hinting at volatility. Size your range accordingly; the codex records which weather you read well.
hook: Teaches volatility regimes through a playful metaphor.
risk: Weather hint accuracy must be honest, not tuned to flatter.

name: Stop Loss Shrine
loop: Each room offers a shrine where you pre-commit an exit level before the chart plays. Sticking to the commitment grants shield; overriding it costs shield.
hook: Rewards discipline, not outcomes.
risk: Do not imply specific stop levels are recommended.

name: Seed of the Week
loop: A weekly long seed with twelve rooms; friends play it any time that week. Best risk-adjusted score within the friend league wins bragging rights.
hook: Low-pressure weekly ritual with friends.
risk: Friend leagues need a no-stakes guarantee; no side bets.

name: Time Budget Rooms
loop: Each room's chart replays in real time and you have a time bank for the whole run; deliberating too long drains it. Empty bank ends the run.
hook: Forces instinct versus analysis tension.
risk: Time pressure rewards impulsiveness, the opposite of the app's trust ethos.

name: Insurance Relic
loop: Relics include paper insurance: pay a premium to cap one room's loss. Spend premiums wisely or the bankroll bleeds out before the final floor.
hook: Hedging as a build choice.
risk: Complexity; must show clear paper-only labelling.

name: Prophet or Pauper
loop: State a probability, then size a paper bet by it. Score blends Brier calibration and paper P&L; run ends below 30% of start capital.
hook: Rewards being both right and well-sized.
risk: Blended score hard to explain; paper P&L side could dominate.

name: Linked Trader Ghost
loop: Rooms are replayed from anonymised verified trade entries in the app. Choose whether to enter, then see the verified outcome; compare to the anonymous trader's result.
hook: Ties game to the real verified record product.
risk: De-anonymisation of traders via distinctive paths; privacy review required.

name: Curse Ledger
loop: Opt into curses (no stops, double fee, one-way direction) for score multipliers. Stack curses to climb ascension tiers; fail and you carry the curse to the next run.
hook: Self-chosen constraints, classic roguelike appeal.
risk: Carrying penalties could feel like punishment loops.

name: Three Lives Chart Maze
loop: Three lives, branching path of rooms; a wrong call costs a life, a correct sequence opens a shortcut. Five runs per day.
hook: Branching map gives route choice.
risk: Energy limits can be a dark pattern if purchasable; never sell energy.

name: Regime Codex
loop: Classify each masked room as trend, range, crash, or squeeze before it plays out. Right labels fill codex pages; permadeath resets run but codex persists.
hook: Meta knowledge is the only persistent power.
risk: Pattern labels might imply predictive claims; word as descriptive.

name: Long-Only Pilgrim
loop: Only two states, in or out, matching the app's long-only matching. Hold to stay in; release to exit. Cash drag counts against you.
hook: Simplest possible input, mirrors real long-only records.
risk: Might push bullish bias; include down-market rooms.

name: Correlation Corridor
loop: Each room shows two or three charts; allocate paper capital knowing correlation relics reveal how they move together. Concentrated losses end the run.
hook: Diversification discovered by dying from its absence.
risk: Educational overreach; label as simulation only.

name: Leaderboard Seed Cup
loop: Single daily seed, one run, ranked by lower-bound score that accounts for sample uncertainty, mirroring the app's lower-bound ranking.
hook: Consistent with app philosophy: luck-adjusted ranking.
risk: Public rank may lure play for status.

name: Echo of Your Past
loop: Replay a seed against the ghost of your own earlier run, whose choices are visible after each room. Beat yourself to rank up.
hook: Self-competition lowers social pressure.
risk: Low risk; self-comparison could still drive grind.

name: Gap Down Gauntlet
loop: Rooms are drawn from historic stress days. Each ascension adds one more stress room. Surviving means keeping your calibration score above the cutoff.
hook: Stress rooms feel dramatic yet fair.
risk: Historic crash footage could distress; add calm mode.

name: Merchant of Rules
loop: A merchant sells rule relics for paper capital, so each purchase risks your bankroll. Buy a longer horizon or a tighter spread, then play on.
hook: Economy of rules, classic roguelike shop tension.
risk: Shop loop could normalise paying for edge; keep currency paper-only.

name: Slow Lane Marathon
loop: A single ten minute weekly run of twenty rooms with relics, for players who want depth. Checkpoint save allowed once.
hook: Gives depth seekers a weekly meaty session.
risk: Longer sessions increase engagement time; add break prompts.

name: Blind Pair Rooms
loop: Two masked charts side by side; swipe toward the one that did better over the next 20 bars. Three misses end the run.
hook: Relative judgment is intuitive and fast.
risk: Relative picks could be mistaken for stock picks; hide tickers.

name: Hot Streak Debt
loop: Winning streaks raise a multiplier but also raise the penalty for the next miss, so streaks create debt you must cash out with a safe exit.
hook: Push-your-luck decision at each room.
risk: Push-your-luck is gambling-adjacent; policy likely rejects.

name: Narrow Path Bridge
loop: A bridge narrows with each room. Drag your forecast range; width must fit the bridge to stay up, so you learn to be both calibrated and sharp.
hook: Visual metaphor for sharpness versus coverage.
risk: Synthetic data must be labelled.

name: Option-Free Oracle
loop: Predict three outcome buckets per room (up big, flat, down big) with a probability slider each. Share the seed link so a friend plays your exact rooms.
hook: Bucketed forecasts feel richer than binary.
risk: Extra complexity may deter casual users.

name: Skill Tree of Doubt
loop: Persistent unlocks widen what you may do, such as using finer probability steps, but only after well calibrated runs; overconfident runs lock nothing.
hook: Progression rewards honesty about uncertainty.
risk: Unlocks gating basic features may frustrate.

name: Hidden Horizon
loop: You do not know how many bars each room lasts. Hold to stay in; the room ends at a hidden time. Ascension widens the horizon variance.
hook: Uncertainty about the horizon mirrors real exits.
risk: Randomness may seem unfair.

name: Co-op Relay Run
loop: Two friends alternate rooms of one shared run and one shared drawdown limit. Either's mistake costs both, so you talk it over in chat.
hook: Shared fate creates conversation and bonds.
risk: Blame dynamics; adults only and chat moderation.

name: Trailing Shadow
loop: A shadow trail marks the drawdown from your best point. Ride rooms and learn when the shadow grows too long; the run ends if it exceeds the limit.
hook: Drawdown becomes physical and visible.
risk: Low.

name: Mulligan Token
loop: You hold two mulligans to redo a room after seeing its first bars. Using one lowers that room's max score; spend them or save them for the boss.
hook: Resource management on top of prediction.
risk: Low.

name: Verified Replica Floors
loop: Each floor replays anonymised closed trades from verified records as setups; swipe to take or skip, then the true result reveals. Spectators watch live runs.
hook: Real outcomes provide authentic stakes without money.
risk: Anonymised trades may be re-identifiable; also could read as copy-trading.

name: Dream Portfolio Dive
loop: Allocate paper capital across five abstract assets (A to E) over rebalance rooms. Ascensions add inflation and liquidity shocks.
hook: Abstract assets keep it clean of brand and advice issues.
risk: Abstract assets may feel sterile.

name: Epitaph Recap
loop: When a run ends, an epitaph card lists your cause of death (overconfidence, fee bleed, early exit) with the habit pattern, to be shared if you like.
hook: Post-mortems make failure shareable and funny.
risk: Share cards must carry paper-only disclaimer.

name: Tempo Beat Trader
loop: Rooms arrive on a steady beat; tap up or down in rhythm. Missing the beat counts as flat. Short two minute burst.
hook: Rhythm game feel makes it relaxing.
risk: Rhythm encourages reflex tapping, not thought.

name: Two Seeds One Fate
loop: Challenge a friend on one seeded run; whoever ends with the higher paper bankroll wins, then rematch with the loser choosing a modifier.
hook: Friendly rivalry on identical conditions.
risk: Losers chasing rematches; cap rematches per day.

name: Drawdown Survival Hour
loop: Endless survival: chart rooms keep coming and shrinking drawdown allowance. Score is how many rooms you clear before the limit breaks.
hook: Classic endless mode, quick to understand.
risk: Endless play invites long sessions; cap to one run at a time.

name: Daily Rune Puzzle
loop: Today's roguelike room is a single puzzle: given a relic rule set and five bars, pick the legal action that scores best. Share a spoiler-free result grid.
hook: Word-a-day style habit with roguelike rules.
risk: Daily streak pressure; do not show streak shame.

name: Quiet Room Calibration
loop: Between roguelike runs, take a calming drill: twelve quick probability calls, then a calibration curve is drawn showing where you are over or under confident.
hook: Teaches the meta skill that makes runs last longer.
risk: Low.

name: Lantern Interval Cave
loop: Your lantern light is the range you drag; it dims if ranges miss and widens if too wide. Reach the cave's end with light left.
hook: Visual calibration feedback is intuitive.
risk: Low.

name: Overnight Bag Floors
loop: Each floor offers a choice: close before the overnight gap or carry through. Carrying is risky; ascension raises gap size.
hook: Teaches overnight risk with one binary choice.
risk: Low.

name: Anti-Hindsight Rooms
loop: After each room, you record your call before seeing the chart's later bars, then see the rest. The codex tracks cases where hindsight would have changed your answer.
hook: Turns hindsight bias into a game mechanic.
risk: Low.

name: Relic Synergy Lab
loop: Relics combine: wide stop plus slow horizon changes what is optimal. Share a build code; friends try your relic set on a fresh seed.
hook: Build theorycrafting community.
risk: Build codes could be read as strategies to copy; label as game rules.

name: Paper Bankroll Decay
loop: Idle cash decays each room, forcing you to deploy, while excess risk ends the run. Find the balance between idling and overreaching.
hook: Tension between inaction and recklessness.
risk: Decay punishes caution; might nudge overtrading.

name: Rival Shade Boss
loop: Bosses are shades made from aggregated play styles, such as always bullish or always flat. Beat the shade's paper return in the boss room to advance.
hook: Boss as an archetype teaches bias.
risk: Archetypes must not name real people.

name: Mystery Event Rooms
loop: Event rooms show a short fictional news snippet, then ask for a response. Choices change next room's volatility. Outcomes are fixed by the seed, not random loot.
hook: Narrative flavour like classic event nodes.
risk: Fictional news might imitate real headlines; keep invented.

name: Spectator Run Gallery
loop: Watch a friend's run live with their choices hidden; tap your own prediction on each of their room choices, scored against theirs.
hook: Spectators play along without risk.
risk: Low.

name: Permadeath Codex Unlocks
loop: Every death unlocks a lesson page about what killed you, such as a gap or a whipsaw. No stat bonuses ever, only knowledge.
hook: Dying always teaches something visible.
risk: Low.

name: Squeeze Escape
loop: A short position is squeezed by a rising wall; release to cover before the wall hits your capital. Ascension speeds the wall.
hook: Adrenaline escape feel.
risk: Glamorises shorting; fear-based design.

name: Compounding Tower
loop: Each floor you choose what fraction of paper capital to risk, and learn the geometric drag of big losses; a 50% loss needs 100% to recover.
hook: Compounding becomes felt, not read.
risk: Low.

name: Gate Keeper Quiz
loop: A gatekeeper asks three market-mechanics questions before each ascension unlocks, such as what a gap is. Wrong answers show the explainer.
hook: Education gate with roguelike flavour.
risk: Low.

name: Endless Corridor Sandbox
loop: No death. Free practice corridor where you set your own relic rules and see the calibration curve live.
hook: Safe practice for newcomers before ascensions.
risk: Low.

name: Week Season Descent
loop: Seven daily seeded runs form a week season; your rating is the median of your best five days, so one bad run is forgiven.
hook: Median scoring reduces tilt.
risk: Daily cadence can build habit pressure.

name: Scenario Quest Chapters
loop: A weekly story chapter walks through a historic market episode as a roguelike path with branching decisions; the reveal explains what actually happened.
hook: Story plus mechanics, bite-sized history.
risk: Historic episodes may name real companies; mask.

name: Draft Your Relics
loop: Draft a deck of rule cards before the run, each playable once, such as extend horizon or double sized call. Play them across rooms; no randomness beyond the seed.
hook: Deck-building pre-run layer.
risk: Cards that double sizes could mimic leverage glamour.

name: Honesty Shield
loop: Your shield equals how well your stated confidence matches your hit rate so far. Perfectly honest 70% calls beat boastful 95% calls in total survival.
hook: Honesty as a defensive stat.
risk: Low.

name: Loss Is Loud
loop: Share cards always show your worst room alongside your best, framed equally. Losing rooms get a plain note, never hidden or softened.
hook: Mirrors the app's never-hide-losses rule.
risk: Players may avoid sharing.

name: Tail Event Dice-Free
loop: Each ascension adds a rarer extreme room from history. Range ends must account for the tail; the seed is shown beforehand so outcomes are never dice.
hook: Fair challenge: tails are predictable in kind, not timing.
risk: Low.

name: Sleep Mode Run
loop: Place one call on tomorrow's close direction of an unnamed index-like series in a minute; the result resolves next day and extends a seasonal run's health.
hook: Real-time resolution creates anticipation.
risk: Live data usage may imply signals; keep tickers hidden.

name: Trader Journal Crawl
loop: Before each room write a one-tap reason tag (trend, mean reversion, hunch). At run end see which reason tags earned and lost most.
hook: Self-knowledge insight from your own tags.
risk: Tag results from tiny samples can mislead; show interval.

name: Chart Monster Bestiary
loop: Common chart shapes are drawn as friendly monsters (the Whipsaw, the Staircase). Name the monster in each room and learn its habits in your bestiary.
hook: Collecting cute shapes motivates pattern literacy.
risk: Pattern monsters could imply predictive power.

name: Streak Cashout Ban
loop: Streak bonuses are intentionally absent; instead each ascension removes a visual aid like gridlines. Pure skill measured per call.
hook: Anti-casino design is its own identity.
risk: Lower dopamine may reduce retention.

name: Heat Map Floors
loop: Floors are sector-like groups of masked charts; swipe to overweight or underweight each group versus equal weight, revealing relative performance.
hook: Relative allocation without picking single names.
risk: Sector framing can look like tips.

name: Gambler Mode Mirror
loop: On purpose, a satirical mode where random coin-flip charts reward nothing; it demonstrates that pure luck streaks happen and shows the odds.
hook: Educational reality check on lucky streaks.
risk: Satire could still feel like gambling UI; likely filtered.

name: Fade the Crowd Room
loop: Unlabelled delayed-live series; set a probability for the next hour's direction before seeing the crowd average. Scored later, extending the run's lives.
hook: Independent thought rewarded.
risk: Crowd aggregate may be gamed by coordination.

name: Mentor Relic Hints
loop: A mentor relic reveals one fact about the room, such as the volatility percentile, once per run. Choose which room to spend it in.
hook: One scarce hint is a satisfying resource.
risk: Hint must be descriptive, never directional advice.

name: Two Minute Panic
loop: Replay famous-style crash days, unnamed, in two minutes. Hold to stay invested; release to exit. Learn what panic exit costs versus what staying cost.
hook: Emotion training in a safe sandbox.
risk: Could imply holding through crashes is advice.

name: Seed Cartographer
loop: Players compose a seed by picking room types and difficulty; the best-rated community seeds feature in the weekly cup.
hook: Creator layer extends replay.
risk: User-made seeds need moderation for hidden identifiers.

name: Last Stand Bankroll
loop: Start at 10% of capital with five rooms to recover; an all-in-or-nothing final room tempts you. Calibration score shows if the bet was wise, not just lucky.
hook: Comeback drama.
risk: Teaches desperation bets; chase-loss echo.

name: Cost of Waiting Clock
loop: Flat gets a small paper interest, and each room you may stay flat. See how often flat beats trading; the run summary reports the share of rooms you passed.
hook: Normalises sitting out.
risk: Low.

name: Verified vs Paper Mirror
loop: After a roguelike run, compare your paper curve to an anonymised verified trader's curve over a matching window, with both labelled clearly.
hook: Bridges game and real record product.
risk: Confusion between paper and verified; strict labels.

name: Daily Three Doors
loop: Three doors, each hiding a masked chart and a rule twist. Pick the door whose rule fits the chart best; the reveal shows the outcomes of the others.
hook: Snackable choice puzzle.
risk: Low.

name: Hardcore Ironman Seed
loop: One life per week. Run ends at first drawdown breach; seasonal rating uses lower-bound rank across all attempts.
hook: Prestige for survival.
risk: Prestige may drive anxiety.

name: Quiet Hours Lock
loop: After three runs you get a cooling-off room that only shows a reflection summary, then the game closes for the day.
hook: Humane design as a distinct selling point.
risk: Retention drops; positive for compliance.

name: Rewind Relic
loop: Once per run, rewind five bars and retry a room, but the rewind's cost is permanently a bigger fee in later rooms.
hook: Meaningful tradeoff for second chances.
risk: Low.

name: Cohort of Ghosts
loop: Your run races five ghosts of players with similar skill rating; finishing above three keeps your rating.
hook: Matched competition feels fair.
risk: Skill rating for trading skill could be mistaken for ability claims.

name: Risk Budget Rooms
loop: Each room has a risk budget meter; allocate across assets so the meter stays under cap. Exceeding it halves that room's reward.
hook: Clear constraint puzzle.
risk: Low.

name: Weather Report Drill
loop: Ninety second drill of rain-style probability calls on synthetic series; badge shows your calibration slope, feeding roguelike starting tokens.
hook: Warm up that feeds the main run.
risk: Starting tokens could be perceived as pay-to-win if purchasable.

name: Branch Map Atlas
loop: A branching map where each path leads to a different room type (trend, chop, gap, calm). Plan the route to match your relics, then play.
hook: Route planning adds a strategy layer.
risk: Low.

name: Open Position Dread
loop: Open paper positions carry between rooms and are marked to market on the HUD. Unrealised losses count toward drawdown, as in the app's records.
hook: Teaches open position honesty.
risk: Low.

name: Crowd Seed Vote
loop: Players vote on next week's modifier from three options; the winning rule applies to the weekly seeded cup.
hook: Community ownership of the meta.
risk: Vote brigading.

name: Burnout Meter
loop: A burnout meter rises with every consecutive run in a session and weakens your starting tokens, nudging you to stop and return later.
hook: Rest built into the fiction.
risk: Players may resent the nerf.

name: Bold Leverage Realm
loop: Opt-in paper leverage relics multiply moves up to 5x with fast liquidation; top rank requires surviving it. Intended as a stress test.
hook: High-variance thrill for the daring.
risk: Glamorises leverage; likely violates spirit of policy.

name: Skill vs Luck Autopsy
loop: After each run, replay it against a thousand random players of the same rooms and show where your result falls, to separate skill from luck.
hook: Honest feedback on luck.
risk: Percentile shown may be over-read.

name: Rookie Tutorial Crawl
loop: A guided first run with narrator, safe rooms and tooltips. Completing it unlocks the standard runs; no death on the first run.
hook: Gentle onboarding.
risk: Low.

name: Profile Link Dungeon
loop: Swipe feed style: each card is a masked verified trade entry; guess its outcome bucket. Correct guesses advance a dungeon depth shared on a profile as a game badge, not a trading claim.
hook: Ties swipe feed to game depth.
risk: Game badge on a profile may blur verified meaning.

name: Relay Prediction Chain
loop: Each friend in a chain adds one probability for tomorrow's close direction on a masked series; chain score is the pooled forecast's log score, shared by all.
hook: Team forecasting game.
risk: Free riders; pooling scores obscure individual calibration.

name: Memory Palace Rooms
loop: Revisit rooms from previous runs with their reveal now known; spot what changed and which cue you missed, earning codex pages.
hook: Spaced repetition meets roguelike.
risk: Low.

name: Final Descent Epilogue
loop: Clearing the top ascension opens an epilogue run mixing everything learned: confidence tokens, relics, bosses, drawdown limit. Reward is a cosmetic emblem only.
hook: Clear endgame goal with modest reward.
risk: Low.
